enable_jit: enable the PyTorch JIT compiler globally
disable_jit: disable the PyTorch JIT compiler globally
parse_jit_env: parse the PYTORCH_JIT environment variable to determine JIT enabled state
add_script_class_mapping: add a mapping between a Python class and its JIT ScriptClass
cache_jit_function: cache a JIT-compiled free function keyed by the original function object
